matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the same defect in Theorem 3.3: the presence of the log-sum-exp term in the loss formulation. While the finding calls this term 'erroneous' and the ground truth describes it as an 'omission' (of the original clean formulation), both point to the same inconsistency in the theoretical formulation. Per R2, polarity is irrelevant—the finding detects the same defect even though it frames it from the opposite direction.
No finding addresses the gradient analysis in Section 3.2 or the inconsistency between the gradient formulation and the loss definition regarding coupled logit interactions.
